title: Shopping bags
slide_intent: Let format influence the mark’s proportions because a brand must remain legible on objects with different carrying capacities.
strategic_value: Tall W strokes can use the available surfaces of Whitney’s bags while the name remains prominent near the top.
demonstration: Two white shopping bags of different sizes display large thin Ws and black handles below bold Whitney names.
practical_value: Compare mark scale and word placement between the short wide bag and tall narrow bag.

content_islands.name: Bag pair
content_islands.spec: Place the smaller bag in front at left and the taller bag behind at right; preserve handles and visible side panels.

reference_purposes.Application: The official launch caption identifies the shopping-bag suite for the museum’s retail store.
